profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in Armonk, NY, founded in 1911, with 2024 revenues of $67.535 billion. The company describes its IBM OpenPages platform as a scalable, AI-powered GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) solution that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated system. OpenPages offers modular, cloud-based or on-premises deployment, with embedded AI that automates classification, issue creation, and risk management tasks. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance in its 2026 Vendor Assessment.

IBM's AI governance offerings include IBM watsonx.governance, which provides AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx enterprise AI platform enables agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection through a model-agnostic architecture. OpenPages integrates with watsonx.ai or other third-party and custom models via API-based architecture, avoiding vendor lock-in. The platform includes an OpenPages MCP Server that allows AI agents to securely create, query, and update GRC objects for governed automation.

According to the site, OpenPages features an interactive GRC Canvas for real-time risk visualization and process modeling, open integrations with BI tools and data platforms, and automation for internal audit planning and execution. Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using the platform's AI and machine learning capabilities. IBM has 327 cases on record in New York state.
